facts.form: Large slab, top polished, sides sawn
facts.end_use: Kitchen and bathroom countertops, office furniture surfaces

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 6802 covers worked monumental or building stone
GRI 6: polished (worked beyond simple sawing) goes to 6802.91 or 6802.92 depending on stone type

rejected_alternatives.reason: Top is polished, more than simply cut or sawn
Applies if the stone is limestone rather than marble/travertine
Stone is worked and polished, not merely roughly trimmed or squared

missing_facts: Geological type: marble/travertine versus limestone or other calcareous stone
classification.rationale: Polished slabs of building stone fall in heading 6802. Whether they are marble/travertine (6802.91) or other calcareous stone (6802.92) decides the subheading and is not stated; best guess is marble/travertine.
